subject.title: Feature request: fallback model chain for compaction and LCM summaryModel

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class public fallback config for embedded compaction and, separately, define a plugin-owned or SDK-level contract for Lossless `summaryModel` fallback behavior?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds compatibility-sensitive config and crosses core compaction plus external context-engine ownership, so automation should not choose the API shape.

options.title: Keep Open For Contract Decision
options.body: Leave this issue open while maintainers choose explicit fallback-list semantics, owner boundaries, and required upgrade/docs proof before implementation.

options.title: Approve Embedded-Only Scope
options.body: Accept a narrower core change for `agents.defaults.compaction.fallbacks` and require a separate Lossless/plugin issue for `summaryModel` fallbacks.

options.title: Route Entirely To Plugin Work
options.body: Decline new core config and ask for a compaction-provider or Lossless plugin implementation if maintainers believe current plugin APIs are sufficient.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Contract Decision
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open while maintainers choose explicit fallback-list semantics, owner boundaries, and required upgrade/docs proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest merged-history signal across the compaction config and compaction provider boundary that this decision would extend.
